title: Introducing: Business Central Integration with Microsoft Fabric (2026 release wave 2)

chapters.title: Introduction to Business Central Fabric mirroring
Setup steps 1-2: Configure mirroring database and connect Business Central
Setup step 3: Specify tables, companies, and start synchronization
How data appears in OneLake and SQL endpoint
Power BI apps for Fabric with single and multi-company versions
Monitoring the integration from Business Central and APIs
Monitoring from Fabric and permission sets

features.name: Business Central Fabric mirroring
features.description: Live synchronization of Business Central data to Microsoft Fabric's OneLake foundation, enabling data to be queried through SQL endpoints and used in Power BI apps.
features.status_evidence_quote: this is coming in public preview in version 29.x, likely 9 29.1

features.name: Microsoft Fabric integration app
features.description: New app in Business Central for setting up and managing Fabric integration, including connection setup, table and company selection, and synchronization configuration.
features.status_evidence_quote: this is coming in public preview in version 29.x, likely 9 29.1
caveats: Requires manual connection string setup from Fabric
Configuration packages can be used for ISV solutions

features.name: Mirror database in OneLake
features.description: Tables from Business Central are synchronized and created as Delta Parquet files in Fabric's open mirroring database, abstracted as SQL tables through a SQL endpoint.
features.status_evidence_quote: this is coming in public preview in version 29.x, likely 9 29.1
caveats: Tables are Delta Parquet files, not native SQL tables

features.name: Multi-company Power BI apps
features.description: Power BI apps converted to work on Fabric backend with support for both single-company and multi-company versions, allowing filtering and reporting across multiple companies.
features.status_evidence_quote: In two versions, they will be available uh soon either as code samples or on AppSource
caveats: Single-company versions similar to embedded apps
Nine Power BI apps being delivered

features.name: Synchronization overview and details logs
features.description: Two types of logs written in Business Central for monitoring synchronization: overview and details views, available in client, via APIs, and in Fabric for administrative monitoring.
features.status_evidence_quote: this is coming in public preview in version 29.x, likely 9 29.1
caveats: Includes list views for errors and data
Details page can be used in analysis mode for custom reports

features.name: Fabric integration APIs
features.description: Six new APIs available in Business Central for setup and monitoring of Fabric integration, accessible through the API overview page.
features.status_evidence_quote: this is coming in public preview in version 29.x, likely 9 29.1

features.name: Fabric integration permission sets
features.description: Permission sets restrict who can set up and manage Fabric integration in Business Central, with separate permissions for activation, administration, and read-only configuration access.
features.status_evidence_quote: this is coming in public preview in version 29.x, likely 9 29.1
